title: Effect of a magnetic field on the activity of superoxide dismutase studied at the enzyme level
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,25395-25401

Sangwoo Yoon, Seung-Cheol Chang, Gregory F. Payne, Seunghun Lee, Kwangseuk Kyhm, Sung-Gyu Park, Mijeong Kang
A static magnetic field facilitated superoxide generation in the XOD–xanthine reaction and SOD-mediated scavenging. Electrochemical analyses further showed altered electron transfer at the Cu center of immobilized SOD.
